datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0 THRU BZT52C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52C11 row was selected from the BZT52C2V0 through BZT52C75 electrical-characteristics table.
The Fig. 2 points are digitized readings from the individually labeled BZT52C11 trace; source-axis current in mA was converted to A, and no intermediate points were interpolated.
The BZT52C11 row gives VZ = 10.45 V minimum, 11.00 V nominal, and 11.55 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 20 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK is 150 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and admissible IZM is 5 mA.
The reverse-leakage specification is a maximum IR of 0.1 microampere at VR = 8.0 V and Ta = 25 degC; it was converted to 1e-7 A.
The Fig. 2 series plot is pulsed and includes a PD = 500 mW envelope, while the component maximum-ratings table lists PD = 350 mW; the envelope was not treated as a component-specific rating.

No component-specific capacitance value or reverse-recovery time is published. The capacitance and impedance plots are series-wide typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C11 trace and were not assigned component-specific values.
